e.title: lossratio (R)
e.summary: 长期健康险损失率分析 R 包（fastcashflow 作者）：队列发展/阶段自适应投影/体制检测/回测
e.body: lossratio 是 seokhoonj（fastcashflow IFRS 17 引擎作者）的 R 包：长期健康险损失率分析——队列发展分析、阶段自适应投影、体制（regime）检测与回测验证。对 RIAA：健康险损失率（loss ratio）分析的专门工具（长期健康险的损失率随队列与阶段演进）。与 [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]]（医疗理赔数据）、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]（理赔语料）、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互补。关联 [[longitudinal-reserving]]、[[insurance-governance]]。

e.summary_en: R package for long-term health-insurance loss-ratio analytics (by the fastcashflow author): cohort development, stage-adaptive projection, regime detection, backtest validation
e.summary_hk: 長期健康險損失率分析 R 包（fastcashflow 作者）：隊列發展/階段自適應投影/體制檢測/回測
e.body_en: lossratio is the R package by seokhoonj (author of the fastcashflow IFRS 17 engine): loss-ratio analytics for long-term health insurance — cohort development analysis, stage-adaptive projection, regime detection and backtest validation. For RIAA: a dedicated tool for health-insurance loss-ratio analysis (long-term health loss ratios evolve with cohort and stage). Complements [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]] (medical claims data), [[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]] (claims corpus) and [[actuarial-pricing]]. Related: [[longitudinal-reserving]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: lossratio 是 seokhoonj（fastcashflow IFRS 17 引擎作者）的 R 包：長期健康險損失率分析——隊列發展分析、階段自適應投影、體制（regime）檢測與回測驗證。對 RIAA：健康險損失率（loss ratio）分析的專門工具（長期健康險的損失率隨隊列與階段演進）。與 [[ait168-synthetic-medical-claims]]（醫療理賠數據）、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]（理賠語料）、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互補。關聯 [[longitudinal-reserving]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
